label: Home mortgages, one to four family
numerator: mortgage service paid by households with an employed member aged 25 to 64
denominator: mortgage service paid by all households
proxy_assumption: who pays the service stands in for what income pays it

label: Revolving consumer credit
numerator: card balances owed by working-core households
denominator: card balances owed by all households
source: Survey of Income and Program Participation 2025
proxy_assumption: who owes stands in for what income services the balance

label: Consumer credit, automobile loans
numerator: vehicle loan balances owed by working-core households
denominator: vehicle loan balances owed by all households
source: Survey of Income and Program Participation 2025
proxy_assumption: who owes stands in for what income services the balance

label: Consumer credit, student loans
numerator: student loan balances owed by working-core households
denominator: student loan balances owed by all households
source: Survey of Income and Program Participation 2025
proxy_assumption: who owes stands in for what income services the balance

label: Other non-revolving consumer credit
numerator: balance-weighted mean of the card, auto and student coefficients
proxy_assumption: the residual consumer class is assumed to resemble the three measured ones

label: Multifamily residential mortgages
numerator: gross rent paid by households with an employed member aged 25 to 64
denominator: gross rent paid by all renter households
proxy_assumption: rent is assumed to service the mortgage on the building one for one

label: Treasury securities
numerator: social insurance contributions in full plus the wage share of the individual income tax
source: national accounts and Statistics of Income
proxy_assumption: receipts composition stands in for the composition of debt service

label: State and local government debt
numerator: the wage-linked share of state and local own receipts
source: national accounts and Statistics of Income

label: Corporate bonds, nonfinancial corporate
proxy_assumption: business revenue is not traced further

label: Corporate loans, nonfinancial corporate
proxy_assumption: business revenue is not traced further

label: Nonfinancial noncorporate business loans
proxy_assumption: business revenue is not traced further

label: Commercial mortgages, excluding multifamily
proxy_assumption: rent from business tenants is not traced further

label: Corporate equities, nonfinancial corporate
proxy_assumption: excluded from the debt-only denominator in any case
